title: Simple arcade physics: velocity, gravity and friction
when: Objects need believable motion with acceleration, gravity, drag and speed limits, integrated in fixed ticks so results stay stable on every device.
prompt:
Goal: Motion that feels responsive and stays numerically stable at any frame rate.
Steps:
1. Body { x, y, vx, vy, ax, ay, onGround }; units are pixels and seconds; constants live in js/tuning.js (GRAVITY 1800, MAX_FALL 900, RUN_ACCEL 2400, MAX_RUN 220, GROUND_FRICTION 10, AIR_FRICTION 2).
2. Semi implicit Euler every fixed tick: vx += ax * dt; vy += (ay + GRAVITY) * dt; then x += vx * dt; y += vy * dt.
3. Clamp vy to MAX_FALL and vx to MAX_RUN after accelerating.
4. Friction without input is exponential decay: vx *= Math.exp(-friction * dt), snapping to 0 below 1 px per second.
5. Bounce on contact: v = -v * restitution with restitution between 0 and 1, and rest when the speed falls under a small threshold.
6. Keep the integrator in physics.mjs with no DOM, so node:test can step 60 ticks and check positions.
Quality bar:
- A jump peaks at the same height on a 30 and a 144 Hz screen.
- Objects come to rest instead of jittering forever.
Pitfalls:
- Friction written as vx *= 0.9 per frame, which depends on frame rate.
- Updating position before velocity (explicit Euler), which gains energy in bounces.
- Magic numbers scattered across files instead of one tuning table.
Verify:
- [ ] A test drops a body for 1 s and compares y with 0.5 * g * t * t within 2 percent.
- [ ] A sliding body stops within the expected distance.
Output: js/physics.mjs, js/tuning.js and test/physics.test.mjs.

examples.input: adicionar gravidade e atrito ao meu jogo
examples.output: tuning table, semi implicit Euler per tick, exponential friction, restitution, physics tests
